newsitem.title: UKRAINE: UKRAINE ECONOMY MINISTER SEES RATING BY END AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: UKRAINE ECONOMY MINISTER SEES RATING BY END AUGUST.

text.p: Economy Minister Viktor Suslov said on Wednesday that he expected a decision on Ukraine's credit rating to be taken by the end of this month.
"A final decision on the rating will probably be taken by the end of August, and not here, but in Japan, after all the papers have been analysed," Suslov told a news conference.
Suslov said he could give no further details on the process of Ukraine's entry into international capital markets, which began on Monday with a well-received $450 million one-year note.
The paper was underwritten by Nomura International, which will also underwrite a bond in the yen market in September. Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and J.P. Morgan are to underwrite a second, dollar deal.
